title: Hoard - Cloud Saves
desc: 📦 Hoard Setup & Usage Guide
author: Ryunosuke
content:
# Hoard - Cloud Saves

# 📦 Hoard Setup & Usage Guide
-# Automatic, versioned game save backup & cross-device sync (Windows, Linux, SteamOS & macOS)

## 📋 Overview
Hoard automatically detects 22,000+ games and emulators, watches your save folders in the background, and keeps a full version history so you can sync across PCs or roll back corrupted saves anytime.
* **Hoard One (Cloud):** Free tier includes **2 GB storage**, up to **3 devices**, and full version history.
* **Self-Hosted:** Run your own server via Docker/Unraid with no account or storage limits.

## 1️⃣ Step 1: Download & Install
1. Grab the desktop installer for your OS from [hoard.services](<https://hoard.services/>).
2. Launch Hoard—it runs quietly in your system tray and starts automatically on boot.
3. **Sign In:** Log in with Google or an email magic link for **Hoard One**, or enter your custom server URL and token if self-hosting.

## 2️⃣ Step 2: Detect Your Games & Emulators
1. Hoard automatically scans Steam, Epic, GOG, Xbox, Proton/Wine prefixes, and 20+ emulators using the Ludusavi database.
2. If a title or emulator isn't listed automatically, add its save folder path manually in the **Library** tab.

## 3️⃣ Step 3: Automatic Sync & Version Rollback
* **Auto-Backup:** Every time your game saves, Hoard creates a verified snapshot in the background without touching open game files.
* **Cross-Device Sync:** Close your game on one PC, let the tray icon finish syncing, and your latest save will be waiting on your second PC or Steam Deck.
* **Roll Back a Save:** Close the game, open Hoard's **Library**, select the game, and restore any earlier snapshot version.

![Attached Image](assets/hoard-cloud-saves_1574786593485492285.webp)

title: Impulse Trainer
desc: ⚡ Impulse Setup & Usage Guide
author: Ryunosuke
content:
# Impulse Trainer

# ⚡ Impulse Setup & Usage Guide
-# Lightweight Windows client for game trainers (Overlay, Hotkeys & Phone Remote)

## 1️⃣ Step 1: Set Up Official Wand (WeMod) First
Impulse contains **no trainer binaries** of its own—it borrows your official Wand installation and login session.
1. Download and install the official **Wand (WeMod)** desktop app from [wand.com/download](<https://www.wand.com/download>) (Windows 10/11 64-bit).
2. Open **Wand** and **sign in** to your account *(a free account works)*.
3. **Close Wand completely** *(check your Windows System Tray in the bottom-right corner and quit it if it's still running in the background)*.

## 2️⃣ Step 2: Download & Launch Impulse
1. Grab the latest `Impulse.exe` from [GitHub Releases](<https://github.com/tweak-for-me/impulse/releases>).
2. Run `Impulse.exe` *(right-click -> **Run as administrator** if your game runs with elevated permissions)*.
3. Impulse will automatically detect your Wand login and installed games.

## 3️⃣ Step 3: Load a Game & Attach
1. Pick a game from your library list, or click **`+ Add`** to manually browse and select your game's `.exe` file.
2. Click **`Launch + Attach`** to start the game with mods ready, or launch your game normally first and click **`Attach`**.
3. *(First-time use)* Wait a few seconds while Impulse downloads the trainer files for that specific game.

## 🎮 Controls & Shortcuts
* **In-Game Overlay:** Press `Ctrl + Shift + O` while in-game to open movable panels for mods, maps, and minimaps.
* **Phone Remote:** Click the **Phone icon** in the top title bar -> toggle **Phone access** ON -> scan the QR code *(PC & phone must share the same Wi-Fi)*.
* **Hotkeys & Presets:** Rebind mod hotkeys, pin favorites, or save mod states as **Collections**

![Attached Image](assets/impulse-trainer_1574781477789630606.png)

title: Ludusavi - Cloud Saves
desc: 🛡️ Ludusavi Setup & Usage Guide
author: Ryunosuke
content:
# Ludusavi - Cloud Saves

# 🛡️ Ludusavi Setup & Usage Guide
-# Open-source PC game save backup & restore tool (Windows, Linux & macOS)

## 📋 Overview
Ludusavi scans your PC for installed games across Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, EA, Xbox, Proton/Wine prefixes, and emulators—letting you back up all your local save files in one click without needing an account.

## 1️⃣ Step 1: Download & Launch
1. Grab the latest release for your OS from [GitHub Releases](<https://github.com/mtkennerly/ludusavi/releases>).
2. Unzip the files into a permanent folder *(e.g., `C:\Tools\Ludusavi`)* and launch the Ludusavi app.
3. *(Optional)* In the **Other** tab, set your preferred **Backup target directory** (such as a secondary drive, USB drive, or synced cloud folder like Google Drive/OneDrive).

## 2️⃣ Step 2: Scan & Back Up Saves
1. Open the **Backup** tab and click **`Preview`** to scan your system for all detected game saves.
2. Uncheck any games you want to skip, or leave everything selected.
3. Click **`Back up`** to copy all selected saves into clean, organized backup folders.

## 3️⃣ Step 3: Restore Saves
1. Close the game first so none of its save files are locked.
2. Open the **Restore** tab and click **`Preview`** to list your available backups.
3. Select the game (and snapshot version, if multiple exist) and click **`Restore`**.

## 💡 Useful Tips
* **Custom Save Paths:** If a game isn't detected automatically, add its save folder or registry path manually under the **Custom Games** tab.
* **Cloud Sync Workaround:** Point Ludusavi's backup folder inside your local **OneDrive, Google Drive, or Dropbox** folder to automatically sync your backups across PCs.
* **Playnite / Steam Deck:** Ludusavi integrates directly with Playnite and runs natively on Linux/SteamOS via Flatpak or AppImage.

![Attached Image](assets/ludusavi-cloud-saves_1574787532388831272.gif)

title: OpenSave - Cloud Saves
desc: 💾 OpenSave Setup & Usage Guide
author: Ryunosuke
content:
# OpenSave - Cloud Saves

# 💾 OpenSave Setup & Usage Guide
-# Open-source Steam save manager, backup tool & save swapper for Windows

## 📋 Prerequisites
* **OS:** Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
* **Steam:** Installed locally with your game saves synced/downloaded *(close your game before restoring or swapping saves)*.

## 1️⃣ Step 1: Download & Launch OpenSave
1. Download the latest release ZIP/EXE from [GitHub Releases](<https://github.com/Liquid-co/OpenSave/releases>).
2. Extract the archive to a permanent folder *(e.g., `C:\Tools\OpenSave`)* and run **`OpenSave.exe`**.
3. OpenSave will automatically scan your Steam installation, user accounts, and detected game save folders.

## 2️⃣ Step 2: Back Up & Restore Saves
1. **Select Account & Game:** Choose your Steam profile (if multiple exist) and pick a game from the detected list.
2. **Create Backup:** Click **`Backup`** to save a clean, timestamped snapshot of your current local save files.
3. **Restore Save:** Select any previous snapshot from your backup list and click **`Restore`** *(always close the game first so Steam doesn't overwrite your restored files)*.

## 3️⃣ Step 3: Import / Swap External Saves
1. Download or extract the external save files you want to use.
2. **Back up your existing save first** so you don't lose your original progress.
3. Open the game's save directory directly via OpenSave's **Open Folder** button (or import the save archive) and replace the files with the new save.

## 💡 Important Tips
* **Steam Cloud Warning:** If Steam Cloud is enabled, launch the game immediately after restoring a save—or temporarily toggle off **Steam Cloud** in *Steam -> Game Properties -> General*—so Steam Cloud doesn't revert your local save back to the older cloud version.
* **Custom Games:** If a non-Steam or custom game isn't auto-detected, add its save folder path manually in OpenSave.

content:
# WaterMarkHide

## 🛠️ Hide "Test Mode" & "Windows Insider" Watermark (While Keeping Test Mode ON)

Need `testsigning on` for unsigned drivers, mods, or custom tools—but tired of the **Test Mode** / **Windows Insider Preview** text sitting in the bottom-right corner of your desktop?

Standard `bcdedit` commands turn off Test Mode completely, and third-party patchers often break on newer builds. This standalone `.bat` script patches Windows' local UI strings directly so the desktop stays clean while **Test Mode stays active**.

---

### ✨ What This Script Does
* **Keeps `testsigning` Enabled:** Leaves your BCD boot configuration untouched so unsigned drivers continue working normally.
* **Strips Both Watermarks:** Removes `Test Mode`, `Evaluation copy.`, and `Windows 10/11 Insider Preview` text from `shell32.dll.mui` and `basebrd.dll.mui`.
* **100% Offline & Self-Contained:** No external downloads, no `winget` errors, and no third-party `.exe` files required.
* **Auto-Detects Language & Admin Rights:** Automatically requests UAC elevation and detects your active Windows display language (`en-US`, `en-GB`, etc.).
* **Safe Backup Included:** Saves untouched `.old` copies of the original `.mui` files before patching.

---

### 🚀 How to Run
1. Download the attached **`Hide_Watermark.bat`** file 
2. **Double-click** `Hide_Watermark.bat` and click **Yes** on the Administrator prompt.
3. Wait 2–3 seconds while Windows Explorer automatically restarts.
4. Check the bottom-right corner—the watermark will be gone, and the terminal window will confirm `testsigning Yes`.

> ⚠️ **Note:** Major Windows updates overwrite system UI files. If the watermark ever comes back after an update, just double-click the `.bat` file again.

  * [Ryujinx](<https://ryujinx.org/>) — Accuracy-focused modern Switch emulation.

# Save Game issue?

What did work was the method mentioned by @gokugog, but it needs a bit more clarification on the directory structure. Here is the exact step-by-step that restored my progress:

# 1️⃣ . Navigate to the root save folder:
C:\Games\Phantom Blade Zero\PBZ\ProjectPBZ\Saved\SaveGames
Back up and remove the root save: Find PBZSaveGame.sav in this folder, back it up to your desktop (or another safe folder), and delete it from the original location.

# 2️⃣ . Locate your actual game progress:
Go inside the Steam ID subfolder:
C:\Games\Phantom Blade Zero\PBZ\ProjectPBZ\Saved\SaveGames\Steam\[YourSteamID]\

# 3️⃣ . Copy your active save:
Inside this folder is your regularly updated PBZSaveGame.sav. Copy it.

# 4️⃣ . Paste it into the main save folder:
Drop that copy back into C:\Games\Phantom Blade Zero\PBZ\ProjectPBZ\Saved\SaveGames (the parent directory from Step 1).

Once I launched the game after doing this, my regular save loaded up immediately.
Note: Not entirely sure yet whether the game will automatically update this file or if we have to repeat the copy/paste process after every session.

> Auto-inspects files (`.exe` vs `.zip`). Zip archives are automatically extracted into clean subfolders so trainers are ready to run instantly!

> 🔍 **760+ Game Trainer Library**
> Instant offline/cached search across the entire FLiNG catalog with cover art, version tags, and full release notes.

> 🖥️ **Sleek Dark Mode & Auto-Fit UI**
> Native Windows dark title bar with responsive auto-zoom that adapts to any window or display size without black bars.

> Checks and pulls newly released trainers directly from FLiNG on startup.
